gloss: lean meat; red meat; red flesh (of fish)

definitions.explanation: Meat with little fat, showing a red color. Used for both beef and other meats to distinguish lean cuts from fatty ones.

definitions.gloss: red-fleshed fish (such as tuna or bonito)
definitions.explanation: Fish with red-colored flesh, as opposed to white-fleshed fish. In sushi terminology, refers specifically to the lean part of tuna.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧ (red) and ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ (flesh/meat), referring to meat or fish flesh that is red in color and lean.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {赤身|あかみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: lean meat
- ⟦まぐろ→マグロ：11134_maguro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{赤身|あかみ}: lean tuna
- {赤身|あかみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧: red-fleshed fish
- {赤身|あかみ}⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧: lean portion

SUSHI TERMINOLOGY:
At sushi restaurants, {赤身|あかみ} refers to the leanest part of tuna, as opposed to {中|ちゅう}トロ (medium fatty tuna) and {大|おお}トロ (fatty tuna belly). {赤身|あかみ} is the most affordable of the three and has a clean, straightforward flavor.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脂身|あぶらみ}→脂身：20673_aburami⟧: fatty meat — the opposite of {赤身|あかみ}; the white fatty portion of meat
- ⟦{白身|しろみ}→白身：13692_shiromi⟧: white-fleshed fish — fish with pale flesh like sea bream or flounder; also refers to egg white
